name: client-discovery-store-catalog-special-requests
executionConcern: customer discovery, store/catalog publication and sovereign special-request intake
objective: Make home discovery, store/product browsing, marketing actions, reels and special requests consume only published DSH truth with deterministic destinations and no local catalog or fake operational state.
truthOwner: DSH owns store/catalog/discovery/special-request operational truth; Media owns governed media objects where applicable.
journeys: SHEIN assisted purchase and Awnak errand intake

tasks.objective: Close customer discovery and store/catalog publication end to end
tasks.currentProblem: The client exposes real discovery and store routes, while partner/operator publication can change what the client sees; static presence does not prove one catalog/publication truth or correct hidden/unavailable states.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace discovery/store/catalog queries from app-client through shared clients, contracts, DSH handlers and publication rules; remove parallel local catalog assumptions and preserve server-routed destinations.
tasks.targetState: Only canonically published/serviceable stores, categories, products, media and marketing actions appear, with explicit empty/offline/error states and deterministic destination routing.
tasks.action: Correct canonical DSH publication/discovery sources first, then client projections and operator/partner compatibility readbacks that directly affect client visibility.
mustNotChange: Do not introduce local catalog truth.
Do not hardcode SHEIN/Awnak node identifiers in client routing.
Do not expose unpublished or unauthorized store/product data.
Do not broaden unrelated partner management.
acceptanceCriteria: Search/category/store/product results come from canonical DSH publication.
Special-request destinations remain server-routed and idempotent.
Marketing/reels actions fail safely when target/content is absent or unavailable.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore a parallel truth source.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U002 implementation commit after owner correction, directly affected consumer migration, cleanup and all linked checks.
